{
 "cells": [
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "8d8e847c",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Bayesian Gaussian process latent variable model (Bayesian GPLVM)\n",
    "This notebook shows how to use the Bayesian GPLVM model. This is an unsupervised learning method usually used for dimensionality reduction. For an in-depth overview of GPLVMs,see **[1, 2]**."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "id": "775e7627",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-15T09:26:31.285130Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-15T09:26:31.284931Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-15T09:26:37.351475Z",

    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stderr",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "2026-10-15 09:26:32.088316: I external/local_xla/xla/tsl/cuda/cudart_stub.cc:32] Could not find cuda drivers on your machine, GPU will not be used.\n",
      "2026-10-15 09:26:32.092215: I external/local_xla/xla/tsl/cuda/cudart_stub.cc:32] Could not find cuda drivers on your machine, GPU will not be used.\n",
      "2026-10-15 09:26:32.103672: E external/local_xla/xla/stream_executor/cuda/cuda_fft.cc:477] Unable to register cuFFT factory: Attempting to register factory for plugin cuFFT when one has already been registered\n",
      "WARNING: All log messages before absl::InitializeLog() is called are written to STDERR\n",
      "E0000 00:00:1792056392.124023     108 cuda_dnn.cc:8310] Unable to register cuDNN factory: Attempting to register factory for plugin cuDNN when one has already been registered\n",
      "E0000 00:00:1792056392.129733     108 cuda_blas.cc:1418] Unable to register cuBLAS factory: Attempting to register factory for plugin cuBLAS when one has already been registered\n",
      "2026-10-15 09:26:32.149929: I tensorflow/core/platform/cpu_feature_guard.cc:210] This TensorFlow binary is optimized to use available CPU instructions in performance-critical operations.\n",

   ],
   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import tensorflow as tf\n",
    "\n",
    "import gpflow\n",
    "from gpflow.ci_utils import reduce_in_tests\n",
    "from gpflow.config import (\n",
    "    default_float,\n",
    "    set_default_float,\n",
    "    set_default_summary_fmt,\n",
    ")\n",
    "from gpflow.utilities import ops, print_summary\n",
    "\n",
    "set_default_float(np.float64)\n",
    "set_default_summary_fmt(\"notebook\")\n",
    "\n",
    "%matplotlib inline"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "e371dca6",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Data\n",
    "We are using the \"three phase oil flow\" dataset used initially for demonstrating the Generative Topographic mapping from **[3]**."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "id": "0e06312c",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-15T09:26:37.354944Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-15T09:26:37.354386Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-15T09:26:37.360123Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-15T09:26:37.358884Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "data = np.load(\"./data/three_phase_oil_flow.npz\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "ab049431",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Following the GPflow notation we assume this dataset has a shape of `[num_data, output_dim]`"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "id": "1b4d556c",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-15T09:26:37.362584Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-15T09:26:37.362344Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-15T09:26:37.395064Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-15T09:26:37.394417Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stderr",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "2026-10-15 09:26:37.366233: E external/local_xla/xla/stream_executor/cuda/cuda_driver.cc:152] failed call to cuInit: INTERNAL: CUDA error: Failed call to cuInit: UNKNOWN ERROR (303)\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "Y = tf.convert_to_tensor(data[\"Y\"], dtype=default_float())"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "1540e392",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Integer in $[0, 2]$ indicating to which class the data point belongs (shape `[num_data,]`). Not used for model fitting, only for plotting afterwards."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "id": "b004cfd5",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-15T09:26:37.398042Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-15T09:26:37.397813Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-15T09:26:37.403028Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-15T09:26:37.401948Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "labels = tf.convert_to_tensor(data[\"labels\"])"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "id": "2c20d9de",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-15T09:26:37.405657Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-15T09:26:37.405434Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-15T09:26:37.409695Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-15T09:26:37.408717Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Number of points: 100 and Number of dimensions: 12\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "print(\n",
    "    \"Number of points: {} and Number of dimensions: {}\".format(\n",
    "        Y.shape[0], Y.shape[1]\n",
    "    )\n",
    ")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "a75b5de4",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Model construction\n",
    "\n",
    "We start by initializing the required variables:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "id": "8fdf8779",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-15T09:26:37.412303Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-15T09:26:37.412077Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-15T09:26:37.415786Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-15T09:26:37.414789Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "latent_dim = 2  # number of latent dimensions\n",
    "num_inducing = 20  # number of inducing pts\n",
    "num_data = Y.shape[0]  # number of data points"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "33fd6a4d",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Initialize via PCA:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "id": "22bd2b49",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-15T09:26:37.418431Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-15T09:26:37.418221Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-15T09:26:37.465060Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-15T09:26:37.463874Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "X_mean_init = ops.pca_reduce(Y, latent_dim)\n",
    "X_var_init = tf.ones((num_data, latent_dim), dtype=default_float())"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "a45ec928",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Pick inducing inputs randomly from dataset initialization:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 8,
   "id": "b7a1b3ca",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-15T09:26:37.467747Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-15T09:26:37.467486Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-15T09:26:37.473907Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-15T09:26:37.472656Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "np.random.seed(1)  # for reproducibility\n",
    "inducing_variable = tf.convert_to_tensor(\n",
    "    np.random.permutation(X_mean_init.numpy())[:num_inducing],\n",
    "    dtype=default_float(),\n",
    ")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "ff0cac7f",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "We construct a Squared Exponential (SE) kernel operating on the two-dimensional latent space.\n",
    "The `ARD` parameter stands for Automatic Relevance Determination, which in practice means that\n",
    "we learn a different lengthscale for each of the input dimensions. See [Manipulating kernels](../advanced/kernels.ipynb) for more information."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 9,
   "id": "18e312d9",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-15T09:26:37.476946Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-15T09:26:37.476710Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-15T09:26:37.513657Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-15T09:26:37.512571Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "lengthscales = tf.convert_to_tensor([1.0] * latent_dim, dtype=default_float())\n",
    "kernel = gpflow.kernels.RBF(lengthscales=lengthscales)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "17f27fc0",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "We have all the necessary ingredients to construct the model. GPflow contains an implementation of the Bayesian GPLVM:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 10,
   "id": "ac3a9381",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-15T09:26:37.516500Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-15T09:26:37.516280Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-15T09:26:37.568782Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-15T09:26:37.567347Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "gplvm = gpflow.models.BayesianGPLVM(\n",
    "    Y,\n",
    "    X_data_mean=X_mean_init,\n",
    "    X_data_var=X_var_init,\n",
    "    kernel=kernel,\n",
    "    inducing_variable=inducing_variable,\n",
    ")\n",
    "# Instead of passing an inducing_variable directly, we can also set the num_inducing_variables argument to an integer, which will randomly pick from the data."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "ac5ec9e6",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "We change the default likelihood variance, which is 1, to 0.01."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 11,
   "id": "33682ed8",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-15T09:26:37.571726Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-15T09:26:37.571341Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-15T09:26:37.586343Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-15T09:26:37.585424Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "<tf.Variable 'UnreadVariable' shape=() dtype=float64, numpy=-4.600266525158521>"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 11,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "gplvm.likelihood.variance.assign(0.01)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "ab67acd9",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Next we optimize the created model. Given that this model has a deterministic evidence lower bound (ELBO), we can use SciPy's BFGS optimizer."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 12,
   "id": "dd0b16fc",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-15T09:26:37.589467Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-15T09:26:37.589102Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-15T09:26:47.400934Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-15T09:26:47.399364Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "opt = gpflow.optimizers.Scipy()\n",
    "maxiter = reduce_in_tests(1000)\n",
    "opt.minimize(\n",
    "    gplvm.training_loss,\n",
    "    method=\"BFGS\",\n",
    "    variables=gplvm.trainable_variables,\n",
    "    options=dict(maxiter=maxiter),\n",
    ")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "681584bb",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Model analysis\n",
    "GPflow allows you to inspect the learned model hyperparameters."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 13,
   "id": "2bd1ee7d",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-15T09:26:47.403479Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-15T09:26:47.403137Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-15T09:26:47.435628Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-15T09:26:47.434913Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/html": [
       "<table>\n",
       "<thead>\n",
       "<tr><th>name                             </th><th>class    </th><th>transform       </th><th>prior  </th><th>trainable  </th><th>shape   </th><th>dtype  </th><th>value                               </th></tr>\n",
       "</thead>\n",
       "<tbody>\n",
       "<tr><td>BayesianGPLVM.kernel.variance    </td><td>Parameter</td><td>Softplus        </td><td>       </td><td>True       </td><td>()      </td><td>float64</td><td>0.9180137097589                     </td></tr>\n",
       "<tr><td>BayesianGPLVM.kernel.lengthscales</td><td>Parameter</td><td>Softplus        </td><td>       </td><td>True       </td><td>(2,)    </td><td>float64</td><td>[0.86660823 1.76001   ]             </td></tr>\n",
       "<tr><td>BayesianGPLVM.likelihood.variance</td><td>Parameter</td><td>Softplus + Shift</td><td>       </td><td>True       </td><td>()      </td><td>float64</td><td>0.0064772154934319955               </td></tr>\n",
       "<tr><td>BayesianGPLVM.X_data_mean        </td><td>Parameter</td><td>Identity        </td><td>       </td><td>True       </td><td>(100, 2)</td><td>float64</td><td>[[-7.98769892e-01, 3.04429000e+00...</td></tr>\n",
       "<tr><td>BayesianGPLVM.X_data_var         </td><td>Parameter</td><td>Softplus        </td><td>       </td><td>True       </td><td>(100, 2)</td><td>float64</td><td>[[0.00040637, 0.00153662...         </td></tr>\n",
       "<tr><td>BayesianGPLVM.inducing_variable.Z</td><td>Parameter</td><td>Identity        </td><td>       </td><td>True       </td><td>(20, 2) </td><td>float64</td><td>[[1.31766000e+00, -1.72368000e+00...</td></tr>\n",
       "</tbody>\n",
       "</table>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "print_summary(gplvm)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "3a84a734",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Plotting vs. Principle Component Analysis (PCA)\n",
    "The reduction of the dimensionality of the dataset to two dimensions allows us to visualize the learned manifold.\n",
    "We compare the Bayesian GPLVM's latent space to the deterministic PCA's one."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 14,
   "id": "eab0154c",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-15T09:26:47.438071Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-15T09:26:47.437876Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-15T09:26:47.738365Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-15T09:26:47.737641Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 1000x600 with 2 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "X_pca = ops.pca_reduce(Y, latent_dim).numpy()\n",
    "gplvm_X_mean = gplvm.X_data_mean.numpy()\n",
    "\n",
    "f, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 6))\n",
    "\n",
    "for i in np.unique(labels):\n",
    "    ax[0].scatter(X_pca[labels == i, 0], X_pca[labels == i, 1], label=i)\n",
    "    ax[1].scatter(\n",
    "        gplvm_X_mean[labels == i, 0], gplvm_X_mean[labels == i, 1], label=i\n",
    "    )\n",
    "    ax[0].set_title(\"PCA\")\n",
    "    ax[1].set_title(\"Bayesian GPLVM\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "db5ff02c",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
